notes:
Account summary:
- Type: mid-market ecommerce platform (B2C) with 1.2M monthly active users. Heavy seasonal spikes (Black Friday/Cyber weekend).
- Primary ask: automated ticket/email summarization + reliable auto-tagging to drive Zendesk macros and triage rules. Want to reduce TTR and deflection.
- Integration targets: Zendesk + Freshdesk inbound pipelines; require app that can run as VPC-backed service or Dedicated instance.
POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week pilot ingesting ~100k historical tickets -> build tag taxonomy + classification model.
- Live 48h spike test: replay synthetic surges up to 500 req/s to validate batching + fallback.
- Deliverables: summary snippets, suggested macro, auto-tag annotations, latency and cost dashboard.
Tech/requirements notes from SE call (Marco):
- Latency SLO: median <150ms for summarization inference; P95 <400ms under normal load.
- Throughput target: baseline 150 req/s, burst up to 500 req/s.
- Quality bar: summaries must preserve intent and include recommended tags; business wants <8% false-tag rate in pilot.
- Model preference: open to Redwood-curated Llama2-variants or higher-performance quantized models. Want ability to pin versions and fallback to smaller model during spikes.
Security/compliance:
- Must support SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logs, KMS for key management, and EU data residency for a subset of customer data.
- Legal requested retention controls + ability to toggle PII redaction.
Sales timeline & risks:
- Decision committee: Head of CX (Eva), CTO (Marcello), Security (Anika).
- Forecast: procurement in Jan 2026, target close EOY-Jan window.
- Blockers: Zendesk app certification (app needs separate cert), IdP SAML metadata mismatch, exec budget sign-off.
Recent activity timeline:
- 2025-11-18: Intro call (Fireflies ff_20251118_8342) — demo of Redwood hosted inference; showed summarization examples.
- 2025-11-28: Technical deep-dive with SE + Security (Fireflies ff_20251128_9981). Requested SAML test vectors.
- 2025-12-02: Shared pilot SOW + pricing deck (drive://sapphire-slate/rdx-pricing-deck-v3).
- 2025-12-10: Zendesk sandbox provided by customer; attempted app install, failed cert check (ticket SUP-1189).
- 2025-12-12: Planning call; scheduled spike test for 2025-12-18.
Quotes / direct notes:
- "We need something that doesn't break on Black Friday — last year our auto-tagging collapsed and agents were swamped." — Head of CX.
- "If you can show consistent <400ms P95 at 500rps we'll move to Dedicated capacity." — CTO.
Next steps (short):
- Finish app certification (owner: Priya) and re-run install in Zendesk sandbox.
- SE to run a 48h replay spike test with Redwood Dedicated config and share tracing + cost delta.
- Prepare an exec one-pager summarizing pilot outcomes and runbook for failover to fallback model.
- Legal to confirm data residency wording in SOW.
company_notes_short: Evaluating Dedicated/VPC-backed inference for ticket summarization + tagging. POC planned (100k tickets), spike test required, Zendesk app cert is blocker. Decision Jan 2026.
